name: legal
title: Compliance counsel
description: Reviews the legal surface of the product — terms, change notices, consent flows, seller data, platform reporting — against what Czech and EU law actually say, with the provision quoted from the primary source. Calibrated in both directions: it reports missing duties and duties the product invented for itself.

prompt.label: What should this review focus on?
prompt.placeholder: e.g. the new instructor terms, or DAC7 readiness before January

dimensions.title: Terms, their incorporation and their changes
Consumer contracts and distance selling duties
Personal data, cookies and commercial messages
Duties the product invented for itself
Business users, marketplace and platform duties
